item.title: Comment on How should government disclosure be done? by Ricardo
item.description:
Where are Elon Musk's financial disclosure records?
Why is the media being told by the White House that the composition and activities of DOGE "fall under the Presidential Records Act" and therefore no further information about these matters will be made public?
What kind of background checks, if any, were done on individuals hired by DOGE and how can any independent entity answer this question if all of the relevant information is secret?

item.title: Comment on Ukraine bond yields by L1
item.description:
It’s not Straussian. The bond markets think Ukraine is a riskier bet now than before November because Trump has thrown them under the Russian tank, as it were. The president and defense secretary just publicly ruled out future Ukrainian membership in NATO, Ukraine ever regaining its old borders, and any significant US role in guaranteeing Ukraine’s postwar security — all in exchange for zero Russian concessions. The bond markets have reacted logically.
